message: The other day, I was trying to prep our go-bags while the kids were having one of those epic battles over who got to choose the next snack. I ended up with a pile of mismatched socks in my bag instead of the water bottles I meant to grab! 😂 But it reminded me that prepping doesn’t always have to be perfect—sometimes it’s just about making a little progress amidst the chaos. What’s your go-to tip for getting your kiddos involved in family readiness?
